The Chinese characters for Naomi

Origin and meaning

Naomi is a Hebrew name meaning “pleasantness”.

About the name Naomi

In the Bible, Naomi was the mother-in-law of Ruth.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “pleasantness”, a Naomi calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
